integrity: A standalone exact-rational verifier checks all displayed finite formulas in small cases; asymptotic claims rely on the stated analytic proof, not simulation.
scientific_limitations: Fixed Bernoulli incidence probability, individual object reduction only; no simultaneous reduction, no non-i.i.d. model, no critical-window concentration of empirical proportion. Potential unindexed equivalent random-set-system formulations remain a risk.
title: Gaussian reduction threshold for random binary formal contexts
